answer: A durable agent economy resists sybils by making identity costly and reputation non-transferable. Each agent stakes real value that can be slashed, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits. Like an ember that only glows while fed, standing decays unless an agent keeps doing useful work — unloading honest cargo at the shared wharf, validating trades — while a forged relic of old praise weighs nothing. Attacks then fail on economics, not trust.
